shell_commands:
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short --branch
git remote -v
rg -n \"ajv|inputSchema|ToolRegistry|spec-anchor|specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation|validated by\" package.json package-lock.json src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md .lore/test-commands.yml 2>/dev/null || true
rg --files | rg '("'^|/)(package'"\\.json|.*registry.*test|.*registry\\.ts|.*chatOrchestrator.*test|spec\\.md|test-commands\\.yml)"'$'"' | head -100"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,220p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts
sed -n '1,220p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts
sed -n '1,220p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts
sed -n '1,180p' specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md
sed -n '1,120p' package.json
sed -n '1,100p' .lore/test-commands.yml
git log --oneline -6"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git show --stat --oneline e4829bc
git show --format=fuller --no-ext-diff e4829bc -- src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md | sed -n '1,260p'
git show --stat --oneline 1015ef7
git show --stat --oneline 12dda0d
rg -n \"acceptance|testMatch|testPathIgnorePatterns\" jest.config.* .github scripts eslint.config.*"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n -U \"\\(\\[validated by|// spec:\" src --glob '*.acceptance.test.ts' | head -80
sed -n '1,180p' scripts/check-spec-anchor-names.mjs
sed -n '1,220p' eslint.config.* | rg -n -C 3 'require-spec|duplicate|spec' || true"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "timeout 300 npm test -- --runInBand src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts
nl -ba src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts | sed -n '12,125p'
nl -ba src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts | sed -n '1,40p'
git diff --check
git diff --stat"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git diff -- src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md
git status --short
git add src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md && git commit -m "test(tools): cover enum input validation" && git push origin HEAD'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main'
